summary_en: Universal Engeisha executed a block trade buyback of 50,200 shares (0.5% of outstanding shares) at ¥2,699 per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 17, 2025, for a total consideration of approximately ¥135.5 million. The buyback aims to enhance capital efficiency and improve shareholder returns.
title_en: Announcement Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Unsolicited Off-Exchange Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 16, 2025, the board of Universal Engeisha passed a resolution to acquire 50,200 treasury shares, representing 0.5% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), through an off-exchange block trade on the Tokyo Stock Exchange using the ToSTNeT-3 facility.

The buyback was executed on November 17, 2025, at the previous day's closing price of ¥2,699 per share, resulting in a total purchase amount of ¥135,489,800. The transaction took the form of a single block trade order during the 8:45 a.m. trading window and was limited to that specific time slot. The actual acquisition was contingent on matching sell orders in the market at the specified price.

The company stated that the buyback is intended to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns. Results of the execution were to be disclosed following the completion of trading on November 17, 2025.
